verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results scraping API, not an answer engine. Its only on-topic evidence is a use-case page about retrieving Google AI Mode's AI-generated answers, which implies a single call can return an LLM-generated answer with the content it draws on. The markdown output and RAG positioning are developer building blocks for constructing answers, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented AI Mode/AI Overview endpoint details showing the answer text and source citations in the response, any first-party answer-generation capability, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
